name: In Your Shadow
source:
Two old friends find an old poster for a play they did when they had particular... irritated emotions towards the other. 

[From [url=https://cedesdcc.itch.io/in-your-shadow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两位老朋友翻出了一张旧戏剧海报——当年排演那出戏时，两人对彼此正怀着某种格外……窝火的微妙情绪。
